3_rawAcquisitionCoverageIncludingStaged.denominator: price sessions + benchmark/macro expected observations + KIBOR business days x 18 series. The SBP policy rate is excluded from both sides: an irregular event series has no expected count to divide by

SBP_POLICY_RATE.why: an irregular event series: it prints only when the rate changes, so there is no expected count to divide by

PSX_DELISTED_HISTORY.why: the expected count would be the sessions those symbols traded, which is exactly what was acquired; dividing one by the other is circular
